title: Vietnamese-Style Hot Italian Sausage Pasta
description: A spicy twist on a classic Italian pasta dish, featuring hot Italian sausage and a blend of Vietnamese flavors.

ingredients.name: Tofu (marinated in soy sauce, lime juice, and sugar)

instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat.
Add sausage and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add smoked paprika, chili flakes, and curry powder. Cook for 1 minute.
Add marinaded tofu and cook until browned.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in cooked pasta, salt, and black pepper.
Toss to combine and top with fresh basil.
